relations.subject: John Henry Wright
relations.evidence: His father, Dr. Austin Hazen Wright (1811-1865) was a medical missionary (Dartmouth alumnus, 1830) in Persia from 1840 to 1865, with an interest in archaeology; and an Oriental scholar.

relations.subject: John Henry Wright
